about_the_game:
FEATURES

  • First-person shooter with survival horror elements

  • Scientific horror atmosphere

  • Low-poly graphics aesthetics reminiscent of late 90's games

  • Expanding on the story established in 'Snowsquall Grip', 'Re.Surs', and 'Plastomorphosis'

STORY

  • In the heart of Modern-City, the Continent's sprawling capital, an ominous discovery was made — dark energy particles accumulating at an unprecedented rate.

  • The Supreme One's Government immediately started the construction of a classified laboratory complex within the imposing Nexus Tower — a colossal structure that dominates the skyline, serving as both governmental headquarters and research facility.

  • Scientists studying the mysterious concentration proposed the "Synthesis" experiment — an ambitious attempt to isolate and manipulate a single dark particle.

  • Success would unlock the secrets of the Re.Surs, the unique dark energy that has permeated the entire Continent since the events documented in the "Snowsquall Grip" classified event.

  • But now this catastrophic failure threatens the future of not only Modern-City, but all life on the Continent.

  • As the assistant researcher arriving late to your shift, you alone must contain the corruption that scientists couldn't control.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains different horror themes, blood, gore (such as corpses), depictions of death, and violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 — 5th gen or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better (Full HD ~60fps); Intel UHD 630 or better (HD ~30fps)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 16:9 (16:10) Display Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Emergency Protocol activated: Dark Energy Particle Synthesis failed. Now you — late and alone — must navigate a facility where science and sanity have collapsed. Face entities born from dark energy corruption in this atmospheric FPS-horror hybrid where human ambition meets primal terror.
